name: Wise Council
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, paladin 3, shaman 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

Your words hold more weight and are delivered in a more believable fashion.

You gain a +20 on Diplomacy checks made to alleviate despair (See New Skill Uses), convince others to restrain hostilities via Make a Request, or to improve attitude above hostile or unfriendly. This does not provide a bonus toward improving any attitude above unfriendly, gathering information, making other requests, suggesting courses of action or bartering.
